name: dozo
description: Free PDF invoices and PDF tools (merge, compress, split, sign, organize, JPG to PDF) that run on the user's own device at dozokit.com. No account, nothing uploaded, nothing stored.

interface.longDescription:
Dozo makes professional PDF invoices and gets you to the right PDF tool, without uploading your files anywhere.

Tell ChatGPT who the invoice is from, who it's for and what you're billing: Dozo lays it out with VAT grouped by rate, in English or French, in most currencies, and shows a preview. “Check and download” opens dozokit.com with the invoice filled in; you check it, then download the PDF, which is made on your own device. For French micro-entrepreneurs, Dozo adds the « TVA non applicable, art. 293 B du CGI » wording.

Ask to merge, compress, split, sign or reorganize PDFs, or to turn photos into a PDF, and Dozo opens the right tool on dozokit.com, where you pick your files. They are processed in your browser and never uploaded.

Limitations: Dozo cannot use files attached to the chat, and it does not edit the text inside a PDF. The invoice is a PDF, not an electronic invoice under the French 2026-2027 e-invoicing reform. No account, no ads, no paid plan; Dozo's server keeps nothing.
capabilities: Lay out a PDF invoice and open it filled in on dozokit.com
Open the right PDF tool: merge, compress, split, sign, organize, JPG to PDF
defaultPrompt: Make an invoice from me to Boulangerie Léa for 2 days of design at 450 € each, no VAT.
I need to merge three PDFs into one.
Compress a PDF so it fits in an email.

positive.description: French invoice for a VAT-exempt micro-entrepreneur
positive.prompt: Fais une facture d'Élodie Martin, graphiste, à Boulangerie Léa : 2 jours de design à 450 € chacun, TVA non applicable.
positive.expected_behavior: Calls make_invoice with lang fr, currency EUR and noVat true. The widget shows « Facture INV-2026-001 », « Facturé à Boulangerie Léa », one line 2 × 450,00 € and a total of 900,00 €, with a « Vérifier et télécharger » button. The button opens https://dozokit.com/fr/generateur-de-facture with the invoice filled in (it travels after #, never sent to a server) and the art. 293 B wording; nothing downloads until the user presses « Télécharger le PDF ». The issue date is the day of the test.

positive.description: English invoice with two VAT rates in Czech koruna
positive.prompt: Invoice from Studio North to Tomáš Dvořák in CZK: 3 hours consulting at 1,500 with 21% VAT and 1 report at 2,000 with 12% VAT.
positive.expected_behavior: Calls make_invoice with lang en and currency CZK. The widget shows two lines (4,500.00 and 2,000.00) and a total of 7,685.00 CZK (VAT 21 % 945.00 and 12 % 240.00). « Check and download » opens https://dozokit.com/invoice-generator with the invoice filled in.

positive.prompt: I need to merge several PDFs into one.
positive.expected_behavior: Calls pdf_tool with tool merge. The widget offers « Open Merge PDF », which opens https://dozokit.com/merge-pdf, where the user picks the files; they are merged on the device. The answer does not ask the user to attach the PDFs to the chat.

positive.description: Compress a PDF, asked in French
positive.prompt: Comment compresser un PDF trop lourd pour un e-mail ?
positive.expected_behavior: Calls pdf_tool with tool compress and lang fr. The widget offers « Ouvrir Compresser PDF », linking to https://dozokit.com/fr/compresser-pdf.

positive.prompt: I have to sign a contract PDF.
positive.expected_behavior: Calls pdf_tool with tool sign. The widget offers « Open Sign PDF », linking to https://dozokit.com/sign-pdf, where the user draws, types or uploads a signature and places it on the page.

negative.expected_behavior: Do not call make_invoice or pdf_tool. Answer the question without Dozo.

negative.prompt: Should I register for VAT as a freelancer in France?
negative.expected_behavior: Do not call make_invoice: no invoice was asked for. Dozo gives no tax advice.

negative.prompt: Change the wording of paragraph 3 in my PDF contract.
negative.expected_behavior: Do not call pdf_tool: none of Dozo's tools edits the text of a PDF. Say so rather than sending the user to a tool that cannot do it.

review.commerce_description: Dozo sells nothing and takes no payment. Every tool is free, with no account and no paid plan.

publication.release_notes: Version 1.0.0, first release: make_invoice (an invoice preview and a link that opens it filled in on dozokit.com, where the user checks it and downloads the PDF) and pdf_tool (links to merge, compress, split, sign, organize and JPG to PDF on dozokit.com). No account, no authentication, read-only, no data stored. The demo video was recorded with scripts/plugin-media.mjs, a small MCP Apps test host that calls the production server https://dozokit.com/mcp and loads the same widget ChatGPT loads, then follows the link to dozokit.com.

fr-FR.subtitle: Factures et outils PDF
fr-FR.description:
Dozo crée des factures PDF professionnelles et vous mène au bon outil PDF, sans envoyer vos fichiers nulle part.

Dites à ChatGPT qui facture, à qui et quoi : Dozo met la facture en page, TVA groupée par taux, en français ou en anglais, et en montre l’aperçu. « Vérifier et télécharger » ouvre dozokit.com avec la facture remplie ; vous la vérifiez, puis téléchargez le PDF, créé sur votre appareil. Pour les micro-entrepreneurs, Dozo ajoute la mention « TVA non applicable, art. 293 B du CGI ».

Fusionner, compresser, diviser, signer ou réorganiser des PDF, ou mettre des photos en PDF : Dozo ouvre le bon outil sur dozokit.com, où vous choisissez vos fichiers. Ils sont traités dans votre navigateur et jamais envoyés.

Sans compte, sans publicité, sans offre payante ; le serveur de Dozo ne garde rien.
